artworks.title: The Tunnel in the Park
artworks.description: The image shows a perspective from underneath a series of large stone arches. One arch is prominent in the middle, with another to the right. A river is visible on the horizon, crossed by a bridge that extends beyond the arches. The arches have a textured appearance with bold brushstrokes, suggesting an older structure. The ground is uneven, leading under the arches and into a tunnel on the left, creating a sense of depth. In the distance, beyond the bridge, a body of water is visible with sailboats. The color palette is monochromatic, focused on black and grey shades. The texture is rich, emphasizing natural and manmade structures with various densities of stippling and sweeping strokes.

artworks.title: Wertheim, Leipziger-Platz, Berlin
artworks.description: This print shows a detailed rendering of a large building seen from a street-level perspective. The building has large arched openings at the bottom that appear to be flanked by statues. It is very tall, with a flat roof, ornate carvings, and what appear to be long columns or windows. On the street below, large crowds of people walk by; they appear tiny compared to the building. There are carriages or cars out in front of the building, and a trolly passes by on the street. On the other side of the street, on the right side of the print, there are tall trees and streetlamps. A cloudy sky is overhead. The color palate is monochromatic, with light gray lines on white paper.

artworks.title: Independence Square and the State House
artworks.description: The image shows a view of a park or garden with a historical building in the center featuring a tower. Trees and park furniture obscure the horizon. The building's tower and spire draw the eye against a light sky. The style is sketch-like with expressive brushstrokes creating texture in the foliage and architectural details. The monochromatic color palette of black and white emphasizes light and shadow. Trees frame the building, with more trees and indistinct figures in the distance.

artworks.title: The Cathedral Door
artworks.description: The image depicts towering cliffs curving with grandeur. The perspective is from a lower angle looking up at the rock formations, emphasizing their scale. The horizon is not clearly visible due to the dominating cliffs. The artwork appears to be a lithograph, showcasing detailed linework capturing the texture of the rock surfaces. The color palette is monochromatic with black and gray shades on a light background. There are rock formations and sparse vegetation in the foreground, a flowing cascade amidst steep cliffs, and trees in the distance near the top of the cliffs. The scene conveys natural majesty and the power of geological formations.

artworks.title: The Temple
artworks.description: The image shows a view of a canyon with steep rocky cliffs on either side. The perspective is elevated, giving a sense of the rugged terrain below. The cliffs are detailed with expressive lines, showing texture and depth. In the distance, a mesa-like formation rises prominently against a textured sky. The horizon blends with the rock formations. The artwork uses a monochromatic palette of gray shades to emphasize light and shadow.

artworks.title: Sunset Cities in the Canyon
artworks.description: The image shows a canyon landscape with grand geological formations. A row of clouds is visible above the horizon line. The canyon walls have varied tones and textures, transitioning from dark to light shades. The color palette is predominantly gray and black, emphasizing light and shadow.

artworks.title: Rossetti's House
artworks.description: The image depicts a view from street level, looking towards an ornate building behind a decorative wrought-iron fence with grand gates. The scene shows the intricate detailing of the building, adorned with foliage. The roofline is highlighted by a statue on top. The artwork appears to be an etching, with fine lines and cross-hatching providing texture to both the building and foliage. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of brown and beige. Two figures walk along the street, adding scale and life to the scene. Trees frame the composition on the right side.

artworks.title: Below Chestnut St. Bridge, Philadelphia
artworks.description: The image shows a perspective of a scene with ships docked on calm water. Two large ships are on the right side with detailed rigging, masts, and their reflections on the water. More ships are visible further out, along with other details like figures and moored boats on the dock. The horizon is low, with structures and ships in the distance. The sky has wispy clouds, and the entire image is rendered in detailed line work in a monochrome palette of black and off-white.

artworks.title: The Eads Bridge, St. Louis [top]
artworks.description: The image shows a bridge over a river. Both ends of the bridge are visible. The horizon is about one-third from the top, defined by the top edge of the bridge and a distant skyline. The artwork has sketch-like strokes in an impressionistic style, with minimal detail. The color palette is monochromatic in shades of gray. Closest to us is grass and open space leading to the riverbank, with a few figures. A steamboat is under the bridge, emitting smoke. In the distance are more structures and smaller archways under the bridge. The bridge is detailed, with an arched structure.

artworks.title: The City Bridge, St. Louis [bottom]
artworks.description: The image depicts a steel bridge crossing a river, with a cityscape in the distance. The scene shows fine and delicate brushstrokes suggesting vegetation, worn paths, and distant buildings blending into the horizon. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of grey and white. A signature is visible in the corner of the image.

artworks.title: Christ Crowned with Thorns
artworks.description: This is a painting of four figures in a scene. The central figure sits passively with a halo above their head and a crown-like object on top. Surrounding figures are depicted in dynamic poses: one figure on the left raises a stick, another figure on the right leans forward while holding a staff, and the figure in the foreground appears to be presenting something. Each figure is dressed in distinctly colored garments: the central figure in red, the left figure in green, the right figure in red, and the foreground figure in blue. The background features swirling blue and beige patterns. The style is reminiscent of medieval or early Renaissance woodcuts with bold outlines and a limited color palette.

artworks.title: The Levee from Eads Bridge, St. Louis
artworks.description: The image shows an industrial setting with a river running through the center. Smokestacks and a factory silhouette appear on the horizon with smoke. The artwork features precise, linear brushstrokes and cross-hatching, illustrating urban structures and industrial machinery. The color scheme is monochrome, using shades of gray, emphasizing contrasts and depth. In the foreground, a busy street scene displays several vehicles and trams moving. Further back, the environment becomes more industrial, with a bridge crossing the river and additional factories.

artworks.title: Christ Church, St. Louis
artworks.description: This image shows an elevated view overlooking a cityscape with a blurred horizon covered in haze. The city structures align with the horizon. In the center, a prominent structure with spires is silhouetted against a sky filled with swirling clouds. The style is impressionistic, with sketchy brushstrokes creating a soft focus effect. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of grey and black to contrast the dark buildings with the lighter sky. Additional distant buildings are faintly visible in the misty background.

artworks.title: Train Yard, St. Louis
artworks.description: The image presents an elevated view of a rail yard with steam obscuring the horizon. Factory buildings rise through the haze, with a monochromatic color palette of grey and white. Railway tracks and trains are visible in the foreground, enveloped in swirling steam, creating a dynamic atmosphere.

artworks.title: Eads Bridge, St. Louis
artworks.description: This image shows a view from beneath a large bridge looking across a wide body of water. The bridge extends diagonally from the lower left to the upper right, displaying its sturdy structure. The horizon is above the middle of the image, with blurred outlines of buildings visible beyond the bridge. The sketch lines are detailed with a stippled texture, creating an almost Impressionistic style. The color palette is monochromatic with shades of gray and black for shadows and light. The sky is lightly sketched with soft, cloudy forms.

artworks.title: The Facade of the Parthenon, Sunset
artworks.description: The image shows the Parthenon from a low angle, slightly left of center. The horizon is low with steps leading up to the Parthenon. In the distance to the left, another structure can be seen. The painting uses dense brushstrokes in black and white, creating a dramatic sky and texture on the structures. The color palette is grayscale, adding to the historic atmosphere. Closest to the viewer, rough stones lead the eye up to the ruins.

artworks.title: Night in the Yosemite
artworks.description: The image shows towering mountains dominating a nighttime landscape. The mountains rise steeply with textured and detailed faces and ridges. The horizon is above the water meeting the mountains. Brushstrokes are dense and pointillistic, providing depth and texture. The color palette is monochromatic in shades of black, gray, and white. The water reflects light variations, and trees frame the right side.

artworks.title: The Temples on the Wall, Girgenti
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with ancient ruins on a hill. The horizon is above the center, revealing distant mountains and cloudy skies. The ruins on the hill appear as classical structures, possibly temples, with distinct columns. The artwork uses detailed pencil or charcoal strokes for texture, with smudged lines for the clouds. The color palette is monochromatic, mainly shades of gray. Stones and vegetation are seen in the foreground, leading to the clearer ruins on the slope. In the background, hills fade into a misty atmosphere.

artworks.title: Corinth, towards the Gulf
artworks.description: The image depicts a classical ruin with tall columns near the center-right. The viewpoint is slightly elevated, looking over the remains of walls and stone paths. The horizon is low with distant hills or low mountains. The sky is light with faint cloud outlines. The brushstrokes are rough and sketchy, outlining structural details. The color palette is primarily grayscale, creating an aged and historical atmosphere.

artworks.title: Acro, Corinth from Corinth
artworks.description: The image shows ancient ruins against a mountainous backdrop. Tall columns dominate the scene, with one prominent column on the right side. The columns rise vertically against rolling hills and a distinctive peak in the distance. The horizon is above the hills, creating a flat stretch across the composition. The lines in the artwork display various textures, emphasizing light and shadows. The color palette is monochromatic, with black, white, and grey tones. Swirling cloud patterns fill the sky above the static structure and landscape.

artworks.title: Temple of Jupiter, Evening
artworks.description: The image shows a side view of an ancient structure on the left with towering columns dominating the vertical space. The horizon is low, featuring a distant, shadowy outline of another large, ancient building on a hill to the right. Soft brushstrokes or charcoal shading create a smoky effect. The color palette is monochromatic with varying shades of gray. There is a sense of balance between the structure in the foreground and the architecture in the background. The sky appears overcast, adding to the somber tone of the scene.

artworks.title: The Bright Angel Trail
artworks.description: The image shows a canyon landscape. The view is from an elevated position, overlooking rocky cliffs and valleys. The horizon line is high, showing distant terrain. The cliffs blend subtly with the sky. The rock formations are detailed with textures, creating depth. The composition is monochromatic, using various shades of grey to show light and shadow. Closest to us are steep rock faces with textures. In the distance, the canyon descends with an interplay of light and dark.

artworks.title: Lower Falls, Yosemite
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with towering cliffs and a waterfall. The perspective leads to the waterfall from a high point in the rocky terrain. The horizon is low, aligning with the base of the cliffs. The artwork uses a lithographic technique with textured brushstrokes conveying depth to the rocky surface. The color palette is monochromatic with black, white, and gray shades. Closest to us are sparse trees and underbrush, contrasting with the geological structure beyond.
